about_the_game:
You are a mech. You collect iron. But you're building something different.

Combat Escalates

Your first strike connects. Clean impact. You strike again. Effects start growing. Screen shake intensifies. Sounds boom. Visual impacts amplify with each successful hit.

You keep attacking. The feedback keeps climbing. Effects layer. Shake gets stronger. Sounds get heavier. What started simple becomes extreme. By the end you can barely track what's happening.

But you're building power. Your enemy's building power. Both climbing. You need to overwhelm them before you overheat.

You Weld Yourself Together

Between fights, you explore rusted landscapes. Collect parts from failed mechs. Install launchers. Heavy strikes. Range attacks. Defensive tech. Whatever you need.

Then you build your moveset. Launch enemies into air combos? Chain rapid strikes? Counter with precision? Crush with heavy attacks? You choose every move. You wire it together.

Same parts available to everyone. Completely different results based on what you build.

Your Build Will Fail

Some enemy will break your carefully constructed system. Your timings won't work. Your approach won't penetrate their defense. You'll overheat before they do.

Go back. Swap parts. Change moves. Different approach. The game won't tell you the answer. You figure it out or you lose.

Break The Cycle

Iron's running out. Every mech operates alone. They mine mining scraps. They hoard resources. They fight anyone who gets close. This is the cycle. Endless extraction until there's nothing left.

You're Ironweld. You choose to break it. Build cooperation where there's only isolation. Unite mechs instead of fighting alone. Prove a better system works.

Some will join you. Some will fight you. Both require proving your approach works through combat.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: Dual-core CPU @ 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with OpenGL ES 3.0 support and 2 GB VRAM
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated Sound Card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64 bit
  • Processor: Quad-core CPU @ 2.5 GHz or higher
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with OpenGL ES 3.0 support and 4 GB VRAM
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated Sound Card

short_description: Combat feedback exaggerates as you fight in this 2D Mech Action RPG. Every hit intensifies visual impacts. Sounds rumble louder. Your attacks grow stronger. Overwhelm enemies before you overheat. Build your mech from parts and moves. Fight to unite mechs in a world running out of iron.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Japanese, Russian, Simplified Chinese
